validity_findings.finding: Effective brotli diversity remains 2 variants, not 5 distinct, for 1KB JSON payloads. CDN-noise proxy varies quality per request from {4,5,6,7,8} via quality_rng (seed 1044) but brotli.compress for these sizes collapses q5-8 to identical bytes (q4 distinct). Producer correctly discloses this in validity_notes and known_issues (inherited from parent audit). Effective noise from brotli quality is binary-equivalent; additional diversity in this experiment comes from Accept-Encoding override (br/gzip/identity) and compressed hash variation 2-4 uniques, not from 5-level brotli quality.

validity_findings.finding: CDN-noise proxy cache hit/miss counters show 0/0 due to Python class variable scoping bug (self.cache_hits +=1 creates instance var shadowing class var). Producer discloses bug in observations and validity_notes; actual in-memory cache dict functions correctly as evidenced by X-Cache HIT/MISS both present (20 unique CF-Ray per state, Age range 1-300, Via 1.1 varnish) and encoding diversity across requests for same auth state. Quantitative hit rate (~30% expected) cannot be verified from counters; qualitative cache noise is verified via headers.

validity_findings.finding: Chunked transfer-encoding (~22-35% observed vs 30% spec) is applied by proxy via Transfer-Encoding header and wrap_chunked framing, but HTTP client (requests/urllib3 with decode_content=False) decodes chunked at HTTP layer before body hashing. Body sizes identical for chunked vs non-chunked (e.g., /userinfo no_auth 26-46B both). Decompression pipeline never sees chunked framing bytes; survival verifies HTTP client chunk decoding plus decompression, not decompress handling of chunked framing. Outcome still SURVIVES but description 'tests whether decompression pipeline correctly handles chunked framing before brotli decompression' is imprecise.

validity_findings.finding: Synthetic proxy gap persists: localhost HTTPServer on 127.0.0.1:5001 with seeded RNG cannot exercise real CDN non-determinism (per-edge quality selection, geographic routing, load-balancing, hierarchical cache TTL/invalidation, TLS, connection reuse, latency/packet loss). Decompression via brotli.decompress/gzip.decompress is deterministic by library construction, so within-state decompressed variation 0 (positive control) verifies code correctness not CDN resilience. Null control B-RANDOM ~0.0 is trivial. Test is necessary intermediate gate before real-CDN (per prereg Validity Threats 1-2) but not sufficient for production CDN claim.
